title: Wiki: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Wiki loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Use the Overview for status, Articles for written guidance, Guide Books for physical manuals, and dynamic pages for regions, hazards, machines, missions, and factions.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A first Codex habit is opening the relevant guide before improvising: article, collection, manual, related record, then action.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Wiki is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
